tests.cmd: seed h1..h10 with dup h1 → 6 hosts

tests.name: snapshot_shuffle_canary
tests.cmd: snapshot COPY; shuffle; canary 2 → CANARY plate

tests.name: restore_pin
tests.cmd: restore pre-shuffle order; pin h3 front

tests.name: empty_require
tests.cmd: REQUIRE canary empty EXIT 2; soft shuffle empty rc0

tests.name: grep_h1_cousin
tests.cmd: GREP h1 → h1+h10 n=2; HASLINE h1=1 COUNTLINE=1
tests.note: substring false friend on pure names

tests.name: take_drop_oor

tests.name: shuffle_no_mutate

tests.note: must LET bag = LAST after SHUFFLE

tests.name: coalesce_n

weaknesses.title: SHUFFLE/TAKE/DROP do not mutate named bags — need LET bag = LAST
weaknesses.detail: SYS SHUFFLE bag leaves var bag unchanged; only LAST holds shuffled result. Same for TAKE/DROP/SETMATCH class. Agents that SHUFFLE then WRITE bag persist old order silently.
weaknesses.repro: LET b2=a\nb\nc; SHUFFLE b2; LINES b2 still 3 original order

weaknesses.title: GREP bare host id matches longer cousins (h1→h10)
weaknesses.detail: Pure-name rosters still suffer GREP substring. HASLINE/COUNTLINE exact are safe.

weaknesses.title: TAKE N>depth returns all; DROP N>depth empties — no soft miss flag
weaknesses.detail: TAKE 100 of 6 → 6 lines OK; DROP 100 → empty bag. Canary split with oversize N silently assigns all hosts to canary.

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON collapses multi-line host/canary bags
weaknesses.detail: list dumps hosts as h1h2h3...; canary plate separate. Prefer depth scalars.

weaknesses.title: WRITE often omits final trailing newline
weaknesses.detail: cat -A last host without $ after seed/shuffle.

weaknesses.title: SHUFFLE/PICK share process RNG; CUBALC_SEED only before first srand
weaknesses.detail: Cannot reseed mid-process for reproducible canary redraws after prior RAND/PICK/SHUFFLE.
weaknesses.repro: CUBALC_SEED only if srand not yet called

weaknesses.title: SYS DROP bag-skip vs SYS DROPLINE/REMOVELINE name collision
weaknesses.detail: DROP n skips first n fields; DROPLINE removes exact field. Canary control path uses DROP canary_n bag — easy to call DROPLINE by mistake.
weaknesses.repro: forms: DROP n str vs REMOVELINE bag needle

workarounds: Always LET bag = LAST after SHUFFLE/TAKE/DROP/SETMATCH/MOVELINE
Clamp canary_n with MIN canary_n depth before TAKE
HASLINE/COUNTLINE for identity — not GREP on host ids
COPY snapshot before shuffle; restore soft READ OR
COALESCE ENV N and default string before NUM shuttle
language_gaps: In-place SHUFFLE/TAKE into named bag (or auto-bind option)
TAKE/DROP soft miss when N>depth with distinct OK/LAST_N
Doc cross-link DROP vs DROPLINE clearly
issues_faced: SHUFFLE without LET would have left seed order on disk — rebind is mandatory
GREP h1 vs h10 confirmed on pure-name bags (not only name:status)
canary oversize N would assign all hosts — program relies on TAKE clamp
